excavation_context.character_description: An adult male grad student working as a paleontologist, curly black hair, Black race, wearing a white sun hat. Wears a light purple tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, white shorts and black hiking boots.
excavation_context.stage: Prying Sandstone Beds in an Ancient River Valley

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_3, sporting his signature white sun hat, uses a steel pry bar to crack loose layered slabs of yellowish-orange sandstone out on a wide braided river system floodplain. Splitting the stone reveals the slender, curved tooth rows of an Alectrosaurus maxilla. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
